remarks: Experience over 7,000 sq.ft. of exceptional living space in this extraordinary Orchard Park estate, where timeless elegance meets thoughtful design. Offering 5 BRs, 3 fbs & 2 hbs, every room is thoughtfully designed for comfort, functionality & effortless entertaining. A grand hardwood foyer welcomes you into an interior rich in craftsmanship & character. The elegant sitting room features hardwood flrs & a wood-burning FP, while the adjoining piano room showcases a dramatic dbl-sided FP. One of the home's most remarkable features is the stunning 3-story Brazilian cherry library w/ custom built-ins. The lower level continues to impress w/ a private office, wine room & exceptional multi-level layout. A secondary staircase leads to a cozy sitting area before entering the 12-seat home theater. This level also offers an additional BR, full bath & flexible space ideal for a playroom, hobby room or studio. Designed for entertaining & everyday living, the spacious kitchen features quality wood cabinetry, granite countertops, gas cooktop, dbl wall ovens, refrigerator, dishwasher, built-in espresso machine & abundant workspace. The kitchen flows seamlessly into the inviting family room w/ a FP. The formal DR w/ hardwood flrs provides an elegant setting for special occasions. French doors open to expansive decks overlooking beautifully landscaped grounds, while the adjoining game room leads directly to the library & wine cellar. A convenient 1st-flr laundry & stylish powder room complete the main level. Outside, enjoy your private backyard retreat featuring a spectacular in-ground pool surrounded by mature landscaping. Situated on a dbl lot in Eagle Heights, this property offers privacy, beauty & room to relax. Addl highlights incl exceptional craftsmanship throughout, generously sized rooms & a desirable location close to shopping, dining, parks, golf courses & everyday conveniences. The primary suite features a dedicated sitting area w/ custom built-ins, a luxurious bath, sauna & private exercise room. Completing the home is an oversized 3.5-car garage w/ extensive built-in storage. An additional 134' x 274' lot enhances the park-like setting. Sq.ft. measured by agent.
